core_obligations: Discrete anisotropic resonances do not identify their exact bands or multiplicities in the presence of cone singularities. The authors construct the distribution spaces and differential ladders, identify the surviving classes with first cohomology and control primitives and singularly supported distributions, obtaining the full cohomological resonance formula with the original collision-multiplicity rule.
